/**
 * The package's entry point. Everything a consumer can reach is named here,
 * directly or through a re-export.
 */

export type { Store } from "./store";
export type { Config } from "./config";

/** A function a consumer calls. */
export function removed(n: number): number {
  return n;
}

/** A function whose parameter type one shape narrows. */
export function narrowed(value: string | number): string {
  return String(value);
}

/** A function whose return type one shape widens. */
export function widened(): string | null {
  return "";
}

/** A function whose return type is inferred rather than written down. */
export function inferred() {
  return { timeout: 30 };
}
